description:
Summary:

The FakeTensor dispatch for torch.unique (_unique2, unique_dim,
unique_consecutive) was using arg.new_empty() to create inverse_indices
and counts tensors, which inherits the input tensor's dtype. The real
C++ kernels always create these with dtype=kLong (int64). This mismatch
causes scatter() to fail with "Expected dtype int32/int64 for index"
when using inverse_indices from torch.unique during torch.export.

Test Plan:
buck test fbcode//mode/dev fbcode//caffe2/test:fake_tensor -- test_unique_output_dtype
Pass 2. Fail 0: https://www.internalfb.com/intern/testinfra/testrun/25051272939378423
